=== Header ===
Derived mechanically from the ORM model by `gnd extract` (R-08").
Constraint-blind by specification: object types, reference schemes,
fact-type readings and primitive shapes only — no constraint
sentences, no modality, no provenance. Hand-authoring this file is
banned; regenerate it with `gnd extract MODEL --out DIR`.

=== Object Types ===
Expense is identified by ExpenseId.
ExpenseId is a value of type Integer.
ExpenseStatus is a value of type String.
Approver is identified by ApproverName.
ApproverName is a value of type String.
WorkdaySubmission is identified by SubmissionId.
SubmissionId is a value of type String.
ReimbursementAmount is a value of type Integer.
PaidOn is a value of type Date.

=== Fact Types ===
Expense has status ExpenseStatus
  - expense: Expense (Integer)
  - status: ExpenseStatus (String)

Expense is approved by Approver
  - expense: Expense (Integer)
  - approver: Approver (String)

Expense is submitted to Workday as WorkdaySubmission
  - expense: Expense (Integer)
  - submission: WorkdaySubmission (String)

Expense is reimbursed ReimbursementAmount on PaidOn
  - expense: Expense (Integer)
  - amount: ReimbursementAmount (Integer)
  - paid_on: PaidOn (Date)

=== Operations ===
Expense is approved by Approver
  - expense: Expense (Integer)
  - approver: Approver (String)

Expense is submitted to Workday as WorkdaySubmission

Expense is reimbursed ReimbursementAmount on PaidOn
  - expense: Expense (Integer)
  - submission: WorkdaySubmission (String)
  - approver: Approver (String)
  - amount: ReimbursementAmount (Integer)
  - on_date: PaidOn (Date)
